inputs: Exact hash-verified cached basis, calibration, population coefficients and operators from the frozen local run; no recomputation or recalibration.

paired_probe.baseline_T: Frozen production horizons through 4860, a nested subset of the pilot grid

comparison.return_hashes: Exact equality at matching horizons; exclude the pilot baseline terminal hash at 7290 when the reproduction stops at 4860.

gate: Both complete fitted-policy reproductions and their applicable history hashes must pass before remote production. These are operational numerical-equivalence tolerances; the scientific 5% approximation criteria remain unchanged.

input_transport_plan.description: A separate prerelease will hold the exact existing large numerical caches, with file sizes and SHA-256 hashes in a checked-in manifest. Do not add large basis/operator caches directly to Git. Download and verify them into an isolated temporary output directory on the standard macOS runner.
input_transport_plan.cache_files: P4096 basis; baseline/N300/N1200 P4096 operators; baseline P512 reference operator. Existing calibration and population coefficient files remain canonical.
input_transport_plan.local_production: Continues until the remote fitted-policy gate passes. Any later switch must preserve completed checkpoints and allocate distinct deterministic indices.
